dict.string: LockPlus checks connectivity and latency to your VPN servers and DNS resolvers, which can be on your local network.
LockPlus reads the name of your current Wi-Fi network to apply your Wi-Fi rules. macOS requires Location Services access for this. LockPlus does not track or store your location.
